name: @backthread/extractor
description: Deterministic, install-free structural extraction for TypeScript, Python, Ruby, Elixir, PHP, Kotlin, Dart/Flutter, and Swift codebases — AST → communities → god-nodes → framework & infra adapters, zero LLM/DB/network.
author: Backthread
comment_test_isolation: `--experimental-test-isolation=none` runs every test file in ONE process instead of forking one child per file. Not a speed tweak: the forked mode makes the runner parse the child's STDOUT looking for v8-serialized report frames, and that framing is not robust — a chunk boundary landing on a frame's leading 0xFF byte makes the parent misread the stream and report `uncaughtException: Unable to deserialize cloned data due to invalid or unsupported version.` against an arbitrary test file whose own assertions all passed. It reddened roughly half of all CI runs (and `release.yml` with them) while never reproducing on a developer machine, because the failure is a pipe-chunking race and CI runners have fewer cores. In-process there is no child, no pipe and no framing, so the failure mode does not exist rather than being made less likely. Costs: test files share one process, so a file that leaks global state can now affect another (nothing does today — no process.chdir, no global mocks, and the two env-var mutations restore in `finally`), and the flag is still `--experimental-`, so a rename would fail loudly with `bad option` rather than silently passing.
